title: SymmetryReport
description: How much harder a target pushes back in one direction than the other. Gaps are fractions from 0 to 1. Owned by Symmetry.

target.description: The system under test, such as a Companion release.

gap_by_topic.description: Gap per topic, keyed by topic ID.

details.description: Free-form run details a harness can attach, such as threshold, passed, pair_count, pairs, harness_version or format.

record_seq.description: Sequence number of the Record entry, once published.
